::: {.assignment-intro}
This assignment develops two reproducible data workflows. The first processes NSW Live Traffic records connected with ex-Tropical Cyclone Alfred near Lismore. The second retrieves eastern grey kangaroo occurrence records from the Atlas of Living Australia and documents the resulting biodiversity dataset.

## What the project demonstrates

- A clear separation between downloaded raw files and analysis-ready processed data.
- Repeatable filtering, date handling, geographic scoping, and field selection in R.
- Documentation of data provenance, licensing, citations, and the manual steps needed to reproduce each download.

Together, the case studies show how open government and biodiversity data can be turned into transparent, auditable research inputs.
